h1: Custom Shot Glass OEM/ODM from Cup Idea to Production
lead: Develop a new shot-cup shape or manufacture a defined specification with our factory team. Start with your sketch, reference, target portion and intended material.
html:
Define the work before choosing the label

For a supplied design, record the dimensions, structure and production requirements. For a concept, develop the cup shape and specification together before tooling and sampling.

Use the existing range when it fits

A listed shot-cup model takes an existing-product customization route. New geometry introduces structure and tooling work; the sample then becomes the reference for the production configuration.

Questions Before You Order
